**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 15.1 ("Scope of MSL's Indemnity") gives us a real vendor-side indemnity covering third-party IP infringement (patent, trademark, trade name, copyright, mask work, trade secret, worldwide) arising from MSL's performance and MSL-procured parts/designs/pre-existing materials, plus MSL's failure to comply with law and failure to perform its warranty/support obligations. Section 15.2 adds standard procedure (prompt notice, cooperation, MSL control with our right to participate at our own expense) and the customary procure-licence/redesign remedy. Exclusions are the usual ones (IBM-selected marks, MSL's compliance with IBM written specifications, defects flowing from IBM-supplied designs).

The reciprocal exposure stays narrow: Section 14 of the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement is a loaned-item-only obligation and is expressly IBM's entire obligation, so there is no broad customer indemnity for MSL's services.

Noted but not flagged: no express extension to IBM affiliates, no separate data-breach or gross negligence/wilful misconduct limbs, and no refund remedy — minor gaps against the preferred wording. The 3%-of-bill-of-materials cap in 15.3(b) is drafted to reach "total liability ... regardless of the form of action" and would therefore constrain this indemnity; that belongs to the limitation-of-liability rule and I have not double-flagged it here.
